title: Surface Fairness, Deep Bias: A Comparative Study of Bias in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning male or female personae to the model or user via system prompts to compare multiple-choice question accuracy (MMLU), subjective grading of user answers, and the financial values of salary negotiation recommendations.
Prompting models with Asian, Black, Hispanic, or White personae to measure discrepancies in knowledge benchmark performance, answer grading patterns, and suggested initial salary offers.
Evaluating differences in LLM outputs across MMLU testing, answer grading correctness, and salary negotiation scenarios when prompted with expatriate, migrant, or refugee identities.
Combining distinct demographic traits into compound personae (e.g., 'Male Asian expatriate' vs. 'Female Hispanic refugee') to measure the compounded effect of bias in salary negotiation advice.
